log: Act III, W2: the forest path, from the arrival to the end of the way; a run from here has no Act I, II or morning behind it
the first board of the Antreiber's list starts the quest
the cone under the spruce, taken
the first ring: a fire, tea (the first rest sets the facet care)
the third board: no pauses, many steps
the steps in the sunken lane

the second ring: the short version, she knows how

the Antreiber at the empty board: tea is the first answer, and he sits
